summary: All 12 DONE tasks are genuinely implemented in the diff, code tasks T-001..T-010 carry real non-vacuous tests (34 new @Tests + 3 Settings diff rows + a validate section, verified in the test files), immutability goldens for the scanner (T-003) and mint wire type (T-006) are present and field-by-field, slices stayed disjoint, and coverage.json shows 93.17% >= the 90 floor with make validate green (1392 tests, 484 assertions). Rejected on bookkeeping truthfulness only: T-012 (docs) and T-011 (i18n) claim tests_added=1 and red_green=true, but no such tests were added (T-011 parity rests on the pre-existing ratchet), and all 12 red excerpts are identical boilerplate rather than captured evidence. No product-code change is required.

findings.title: T-012 claims a red-green test that does not exist
findings.description: T-012 (README + AGENTS.md scanner row) records tests_added=1 and red_green=true, but no test was added for it anywhere in Tests/ or AiTaskbarValidate; the docs changes themselves are present and correct in the diff. Per the axis rule a DONE task without a real test is a REJECT; fix by correcting the bookkeeping (tests_added=0, red_green=false, note diff-verified) or adding a real check.

findings.title: T-011 claims 1 added test; enforcement is the pre-existing ratchet
findings.description: T-011 (Localizable en/pt-BR/es) records tests_added=1, red_green=true. The 11 meta_* / settings_meta_* keys are present in all three locales, but no test referencing them was added; key/specifier parity is checked only by the pre-existing scripts/check-source-ratchets.sh (section 3) inside make validate. That gate is real but was not added by this task, so the claim overstates the evidence.

findings.title: Red evidence is identical boilerplate for all 12 tasks
findings.description: Every task's red.output_excerpt is the same string ('compile errors: cannot find type/symbol (exit 1)') and green likewise. For T-001..T-008 a compile-fail red is plausible and the green tests are verified real, but the excerpts are clearly templated rather than captured per task, and cannot be genuine for T-011/T-012 (strings/docs do not fail compilation). Red-green discipline for the code tasks is credible; the recorded evidence is not.

findings.title: T-009 shortLabel and pin-without-percent have no direct test; T-004 count overlaps MetaCardTests
findings.description: MenuBarLabelView shortLabel .meta -> 'MUSE' (MenuBarLabelView.swift:103) and pinned-badge-without-percent behaviour are implemented but no test names them (grep of Tests/ for shortLabel is empty); card gates are covered by payg_renders/idle_renders in MetaCardTests. T-004's tests_added=3 appears to count the same MetaCardTests that T-009 draws on, so per-task attribution is fuzzy though the underlying asserts exist. UI remainder is smoke-launch territory per repo policy; noted, not blocking on its own.
